cause_quote: The classifier added `return !matchesMentionPatterns(remaining, buildMentionRegexes(params.cfg, params.agentId));` for any selected mention, and the new `if (request.humanAddressed)` branch returned before agent dispatch.
user_saw: The agent did not reply to a chat request that copied a teammate with a selected mention unless the request explicitly named the agent.
summary: The fix keeps the agent turn for incidental teammate mentions and suppresses it only when a selected teammate leads the message and the agent is unnamed.
reasoning: I checked the causing commit’s parent, where chat.send validated selected recipients and continued through normal agent dispatch, and an existing integration test exercised a message with a selected mention as a follow-up turn. The causing commit added the classifier and early return, so a request that merely copied a teammate now completed without an agent turn, as the fix PR reproduced.
